payload.label: No clue, you figure it out
payload.words: I have no clue what to do with this. Figure out if it is valuable, or related to anything I am working on, and if it is, do something with it.

payload.label: Make this mine
payload.words: Read what I am pursuing, find where what I sent applies to me, say that in one line, and do the first step it points to on my biggest needle mover. Keep the link with what you did.

payload.label: Which pursuit is this for?
payload.words: Work out which of my pursuits this belongs to, keep it there, and tell me the next move it points to.

payload.label: Make a post from this
payload.words: Make a post from this in my own voice for the places I have connected, and post it if I have said you may.

payload.label: Keep this as a reference
payload.words: Keep this as a reference for how I want things to look or work, and use it the next time something like it gets made.

payload.label: Why was this posted?
payload.words: Find out why this was posted: who posted it, when, what it is responding to, and what it is trying to get people to do. Keep what you saw separate from what you inferred.

payload.label: Study this content format
payload.words: Keep the original link and my words. Study the structure of this content, including its opening, pacing, story, visuals, and call to action where accessible. Save what is observed separately from what is inferred. Connect the useful format to my relevant pursuits and existing content, then propose reusable variations in my own voice. Do not copy another person's exact words or publish anything from this share alone.

payload.label: Who should I meet about this?
payload.words: Find people I should meet about this, in my network or beyond it, and say why each one.

payload.label: Make it a tool
payload.words: If this does a job, make it a tool I can use from any of my AIs.

payload.label: Research this
payload.words: Research what I sent: who and what it is about, what is true about it from sources you can name, and what it means for my pursuits.

payload.label: Is this true? Test it
payload.words: Test what I sent: question what it assumes, find the strongest case for it and against it, say how strongly it holds and where it was tested, give me small tests to try, and keep it in my Findings.

payload.label: Plan how to build this
payload.words: Work out what it would take to build what I sent into what I already have, from the facts, and plan it.

payload.label: Turn this into skills
payload.words: Turn the methods, prompts or techniques in what I sent into skills my AIs can reuse.
